# Story Package: The Resurrection (The Empty Tomb) – Matthew 28, Mark 16, Luke 24, John 20

**Story Key**: `resurrection`

**Position in 365 Roadmap**: Phase 6, Story #27 — The most important story of all: Jesus is alive!

---

## Reverent Read-Aloud Retelling (for ages 3–8)

After Jesus died on the cross, His friends were very sad. They wrapped His body in cloth and laid it in a cave that was used as a tomb. A big, heavy stone was rolled across the entrance.

Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, some of the women who loved Jesus went to the tomb. They wanted to put sweet spices on His body.

When they arrived, they saw that the huge stone had been rolled away! An angel was sitting there, shining like lightning. The women were frightened, but the angel said:

“Do not be afraid. You are looking for Jesus, who was crucified. He is not here — He has risen, just as He said! Come and see the place where He lay. Then go quickly and tell His disciples: ‘He has risen from the dead!’”

The women ran to tell the others with both fear and great joy. Jesus was alive! He had defeated death. Everything He promised was true.

---

## Coloring Page Prompt

Simple, hopeful black-and-white line art for ages 3–8. An empty tomb (cave) with the stone rolled away. An angel with a gentle, shining face sitting on the stone. Three women looking surprised and joyful with spices in their hands. Soft morning light. Clean bold lines, peaceful and happy feeling. Large open spaces.

---

## Read-Along Flow

Color the empty tomb and the angel → listen to the joyful news “He is not here — He has risen!” → celebrate that Jesus is alive and with us every day. This is the story that changes everything.

## Quiz — 5 Questions (with helpful scaffolding)

**1. Why did the women go to the tomb early in the morning?**
- A) They wanted to see if Jesus was still dead
- B) They wanted to put sweet spices on Jesus’ body
- C) They were going to roll the stone away themselves
- D) They were looking for the angel

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “They already believed He was dead. They went to honor His body with spices, like a last loving gift.”
- If C: “They knew the stone was too heavy. They were surprised when they saw it had already been moved.”
- If D: “They didn’t expect an angel. They went to care for Jesus’ body.”

**2. What did the angel say to the women?**
- A) “Jesus is still in the tomb. Go home.”
- B) “Do not be afraid. He is not here — He has risen!”
- C) “You are too late. The soldiers took Him away.”
- D) “Stay here and wait quietly.”

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “The tomb was empty! The angel gave them the best news: Jesus is alive.”
- If C: “No one took Him. He rose from the dead, just as He had promised.”
- If D: “The angel told them to go quickly and tell the others the wonderful news.”

**3. What did the women do after hearing the angel?**
- A) They ran away and never told anyone
- B) They ran to tell the disciples with fear and great joy
- C) They sat down and cried even more
- D) They went home to sleep

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “They were amazed and a little scared, but they obeyed the angel and went to share the good news.”
- If C: “Their sadness turned into joy when they heard Jesus was alive.”
- If D: “They couldn’t keep this news to themselves. They hurried to tell the others.”

**4. Why is the empty tomb such good news?**
- A) Because now there was more room in the garden
- B) Because it shows that Jesus defeated death and is alive forever
- C) Because the women got to keep the spices
- D) Because the stone was easy to move

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “It wasn’t about the garden. The empty tomb means Jesus is alive and with us always.”
- If C: “The spices didn’t matter anymore. The real gift was that death could not hold Jesus.”
- If D: “An angel moved the stone. The important thing is what the empty tomb proves — Jesus is risen!”

**5. What does the resurrection mean for us every day?**
- A) We never have to be sad about anything
- B) Jesus is alive, He loves us, and we can talk to Him and trust Him every single day
- C) We should only think about it on Sundays
- D) Nothing really changed

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “We still have hard days, but we are never alone. Jesus is with us.”
- If C: “The empty tomb is good news for every day, not just one day a week.”
- If D: “Everything changed! Because Jesus is alive, we have hope and can know Him personally.”
